description: This file defines the ADODB2_sybase class, which extends ADODB_DataDict to provide SyBase-specific implementations for data dictionary operations such as type mapping, column modifications, and index creation within the ADOdb database abstraction layer.

classes.name: ADODB2_sybase
classes.description: A class that implements SyBase-specific data dictionary methods for the ADOdb PHP library, including type mapping, SQL generation for column alterations, and index management.

methods.name: MetaType
methods.description: Maps a PHP or field object type to a SyBase-specific type code.

methods.name: ActualType
methods.description: Returns the actual SyBase data type corresponding to a given meta type.

methods.name: AddColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates the SQL statement(s) necessary to add columns to a SyBase table.

methods.name: AlterColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates the SQL statement(s) to alter existing table columns.

methods.name: DropColumnSQL
methods.description: Creates SQL statements to drop specified columns from a table.

methods.name: _createSuffix
methods.description: Constructs a string suffix for column definition SQL based on field properties.

methods.name: _IndexSQL
methods.description: Creates SQL command(s) to create or replace an index on a table.
